changelog:
Discord presence can now show where you actually are in an episode: a live "elapsed / total" progress bar that keeps moving while you watch, the same timeline streaming apps put on their now-playing card.
It is built from the player's own position and duration, so seeking or pausing re-syncs the bar right away instead of letting it drift, and a stream with no known duration simply keeps the plain elapsed timer.
The option sits next to Show Time Elapsed and is off by default; the presence preview in settings draws the same bar, so you can see it before turning it on.
message: Dev build v864 - Discord presence gains a live playback progress bar
